title: Pixelogy: The Blacktide Conspiracy
dialogue_policy: ALL fields ending _exact are the sole canonical on-screen text. Display verbatim; no paraphrases, auto-generated text, or extra scripted lines. Dynamic functional UI labels and player-entered names are outside this constraint.
premise: Blacktide Industries secretly creates coastal pollution, then charges cities to clean it up. A young explorer and red crab uncover evidence, defeat security crab trainers, and stop the dumping operation.
tone: Playful adventure with genuine stakes, lean dialogue, visual storytelling; no preachy monologues or text-slide cinematics.

opening.title: One Tiny Crab

shots.visual_action: Daylight beach, rolling waves, small crabs and a Blacktide billboard.
Evening. Player notices a truck unloading waste behind a fence.

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: Something isn't right.

shots.visual_action: Player carefully approaches bags, cans, cardboard and plastic on the sand.

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: So this is where it's going...

shots.visual_action: Rubbish rustles. A tiny dirty red crab emerges, looks at the player and lifts one claw.

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: Hey... where did you come from?

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: You were hiding in there?

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: You're just a little guy.

shots.visual_action: Player kneels. Baby crab steps closer carrying a small piece of trash like treasure.

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: You want to fight this mess too?

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: Then let's do it together.

shots.visual_action: Worker enters with flashlight after the bond. Baby crab steps between player and worker.

dialogue_exact.speaker: BLACKTIDE WORKER
dialogue_exact.text: You're not supposed to be here.

dialogue_exact.speaker: BLACKTIDE WORKER
dialogue_exact.text: Drop the camera. Walk away.

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: This beach is covered in your trash.

dialogue_exact.speaker: BLACKTIDE WORKER
dialogue_exact.text: You didn't see anything.

dialogue_exact.speaker: BLACKTIDE WORKER
dialogue_exact.text: What, that little crab?

dialogue_exact.speaker: BLACKTIDE WORKER
dialogue_exact.text: Fine. We'll crush you both.

shots.visual_action: Baby crab raises its claws. Worker challenges the player. Iris into the first battle.

dialogue_exact.text: BABY CRAB steps forward!
BLACKTIDE WORKER challenges you!

opening.implementation_note: Approx. 34 seconds. No slideshow. Dialogue sits in a consistent short speech bubble and appears ONLY during corresponding action.

dialogue_exact.speaker: NIA
dialogue_exact.text: Twice. For the same trash.

regions.name: Neon Boardwalk
regions.theme: Night arcade, neon signs, public broadcasting stage, animated billboards
regions.reward: Original footage revealing Blacktide instructed crews to dump trash and fabricate footage

intro.visual_action: Boardwalk game booths and flashing signs. Huge screens repeat a cheerful Blacktide clean-coast commercial; beneath the pier, trash drifts in.

dialogue_exact.speaker: NIA
dialogue_exact.text: They’ve turned cleanup into a show.

intro.visual_action: Player watches two simultaneous feeds: a cropped promotional image and the actual dirty shoreline outside frame.

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: Then let’s show the whole picture.

outro.visual_action: After Vex loses, the broadcast monitor glitches. Player selects unedited source from the control booth, revealing night dumping footage.

dialogue_exact.speaker: VEX
dialogue_exact.text: That footage was never meant to air!

outro.visual_action: Crowd members turn away from Blacktide screens to look at the waterfront; phones show the unedited recording, no magical mass conversion.

dialogue_exact.speaker: NIA
dialogue_exact.text: They can’t crop the truth now.

outro.visual_action: A scientist sends a message: a location pin in the mangroves and a photo of a falsified water-test report.

dialogue_exact.speaker: DR. MARA (MESSAGE)
dialogue_exact.text: If you want proof, come alone.

regions.name: Whispering Mangroves
regions.theme: Bioluminescent wetlands, narrow walkways, silent heron nests, research station
regions.reward: Original samples and lab reports proving Blacktide concealed environmental damage

intro.visual_action: Quiet wetland at twilight. The usual frogs and birds are almost absent. A research lamp clicks on in a small station.

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: It’s too quiet.

intro.visual_action: Dr. Mara meets player, revealing two water-test sheets: one with alarming values, the other stamped APPROVED with changed data.

dialogue_exact.speaker: DR. MARA
dialogue_exact.text: I reported what we found.

dialogue_exact.speaker: DR. MARA
dialogue_exact.text: Blacktide changed every number.

intro.visual_action: Security lights approach along the boardwalk; Mara seals documents in a waterproof case.

dialogue_exact.speaker: DR. MARA
dialogue_exact.text: Pike has the originals. Get them.

outro.visual_action: Pike’s access case cracks open, revealing original test results; Mara checks seals and timestamps.

dialogue_exact.speaker: DR. MARA
dialogue_exact.text: These records prove they knew.

outro.visual_action: Community scientists and rangers begin work on the wetland and reopen one path. Bird calls return softly, but the damage is still visible.
outro.camera: wide tracking shot of careful restoration

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: We’ve got enough to expose them.

outro.visual_action: Mara marks the offshore headquarters on the map and hands over facility access codes.

dialogue_exact.speaker: DR. MARA
dialogue_exact.text: Then we take it to the source.

regions.name: Blacktide Headquarters
regions.theme: Offshore fortified headquarters, shipping machinery, stormy sea, corporate boardroom
regions.reward: Signed executive authorization proving Blacktide intentionally created cleanup demand

intro.visual_action: Corporate offshore facility rises out of rough gray water. An enormous screen still plays the clean-coast jingle, now distorted by wind.

dialogue_exact.speaker: NIA
dialogue_exact.text: The last shipment came from here.

intro.visual_action: Player looks up at spinning conveyor belts routing crates marked WASTE to sites labeled EMERGENCY CONTRACT.
intro.camera: tracking shot along conveyor to office windows

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: They built a business out of making a mess.

intro.visual_action: Crab clangs its equipped armor and steps forward. Headquarters security doors slide open.
intro.camera: tight on crab then dolly into doors

dialogue_exact.speaker: NIA
dialogue_exact.text: Then let’s shut it down.

outro.visual_action: Vale stands stunned in his silent boardroom. The player retrieves a digitally signed order and sends all evidence to investigators and independent journalists.
outro.camera: close up of signature then widen

dialogue_exact.speaker: VALE
dialogue_exact.text: You have no idea what you’ve cost me.

outro.visual_action: Screens throughout the facility change from glossy ads to reports showing documents and investigation announcements. Guards power down their machinery.
outro.camera: wave of screens changing, no instantaneous global disaster fix

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: A lot less than you cost the coast.

outro.visual_action: Nia and Mara board a rescue transport. Crab looks back as the dumping conveyors stop.

dialogue_exact.speaker: NIA
dialogue_exact.text: They can’t hide the record now.

encounters.defeat_visual: Defeated crab lowers claws, trainer reacts in a short original animation. Text appears once, then return to map or region-completion scene.

ending.title: The Coast Belongs to Everyone

shots.visual_action: Wide of the Blacktide offshore platform. Its dumping machinery shuts down section by section. Headlines and evidence appear on reporters’ screens.

dialogue_exact.speaker: NEWS REPORT (RADIO)
dialogue_exact.text: Blacktide executives face a full investigation.

shots.visual_action: Weeks later at Shellshore, volunteers collect safe litter and sort it. Professionals handle hazardous debris. No magical cleanup effect.
shots.camera: pan from volunteers to restored dunes

shots.visual_action: Nia replaces the corrupted billboard with a painted community mural of the coast, the player and crab. Dr. Mara measures clearer water beside the pier.

dialogue_exact.speaker: DR. MARA
dialogue_exact.text: It’ll take time. But the coast is healing.

shots.visual_action: Player looks at red crab wearing the equipment they actually have equipped. Companion proudly snaps its claws.

dialogue_exact.speaker: NIA
dialogue_exact.text: You two started all this.

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: We didn’t do it alone.

shots.visual_action: Crab climbs a small dune with a bottle-cap shield and surveys the shore. Return of motion and color comes from actual habitat restoration, not a magical blast.

dialogue_exact.speaker: PLAYER
dialogue_exact.text: There’s still more shore out there.

shots.visual_action: The region map opens. Completed stages shine; optional postgame cleanup and battle activities remain available.
shots.camera: iris out into interactive story map

ending.implementation_note: Approx. 27 seconds. Credits/title can follow. No unearned real-world cleanup claims; no magic environmental restoration.

implementation_notes.battle: Reuse the current turn-based battle engine and three selected player moves; stage and boss dialogue is only presentation.
implementation_notes.map: Five story regions. Four regular battles + fifth boss each; previously completed nodes replayable; locks enforced; no real-world GPS required in fictional story region map.
implementation_notes.effects: Use original layered pixel-art assets, animation rigs and real transitions rather than still-image/text-card slideshow. No copyrighted assets.
implementation_notes.privacy: Story does not imply photographs confirm cleanup or that unsafe waste should be handled.
